title.narrative: Delivering Accountability through Enhanced Digital Evidence Processing and Analysis: Office of the Prosecutor of the ICC

description.narrative: Contract related to: Delivering Accountability through Enhanced Digital Evidence Processing and Analysis: Office of the Prosecutor of the ICC - In recognition of the significant additional strain on the investigation and prosecution capacity of the International Criminal Court (ICC) stemming from the scale of alleged international crimes committed by Russia in Ukraine, and against a backdrop of rapidly growing demands for processing new types of evidence, this 18-month measure will provide targeted support to the Office of the Prosecutor of the ICC. The aim is to further scale up the Office¿s data storage and processing infrastructure and to build up additional analytical and forensic capacity for new types of evidence, including digital. The support will strengthen efficient and effective data-processing, for example through automated transcription and translation of audio materials and through the provision of additional expert analysts, delivering a critical injection of capacity that will benefit investigative work across all situations addressed by the Office of the Prosecutor. The action will further contribute to global efforts to fight impunity and will specifically strengthen the overall capacity of the ICC to work with massive quantities of audio and visual evidence, thereby facilitating its criminal investigations of the most serious crimes in relation to any situation under consideration by the Court.

title.narrative: Number of people trained by the EUfunded intervention who increased their knowledge of and/or skills in following sustainable land and water management practices (disaggregated by sex, age and population group)

description.narrative: The United Nations defines sustainable land management (SLM) as the use of land resources, including soils, water, animals and plants, for the production of goods to meet changing human needs, while simultaneously ensuring the longterm productive potential of these resources and the maintenance of their environmental functions. This indicator measures how many people have been trained in sustainable land and water management practices.If monitoring capacity is limited or the context is fragile, this indicator could be simplified to monitor only the number of persons trained (without referring to an increase in knowledge and/or skills). However, in order to ensure the quality of training and the achievement of the desired result, it is recommended to assess the knowledge of participants before and after the intervention whenever possible.

description.narrative: The intervention brought the expected change. Obligatory for IcSP Article 3 and NDICI Crisis Response Obligatory for IcSP Article 3 and NDICI Crisis Response

comment.narrative: The project is contributing to the increase of the volume of digital evidence processed by the Office on 25.
This 25 increase in the volume would mean to go from 4.2 TB in Ringtail and 20TB in eVault to 5.25 TB in Ringtail and 25TB in eVault .

The intervention aimed to enhance the digital evidence process and integrations between different systems and evidence review processes and we can consider it to be producing the expected change and making progress towards achieving the objective for several reasons. Firstly there has been a noticeable improvement in the efficiency and effectiveness of handling and searching digital evidence within the systems. This includes faster data retrieval better integration of digital evidence into investigations and improved overall accuracy. Secondly the intervention has led to increased collaboration and communication among relevant stakeholders such as lawyers investigators analysts law enforcement agencies States and forensic experts resulting in smoother integration of digital evidence into legal proceedings. Finally the positive feedback and success stories from various users and beneficiaries of the intervention serve as concrete evidence that it is making a substantial impact. While there is still be room for further improvement and continuous enhancements we can confidently say that progress has been made and the objective is being partly achieved.

comment.narrative: This indicator measures if this intervention has influenced other state parties of the Rome Statute on the contribution to the OTP Trust Fund making it a multilateral instrument for conflict prevention peacebuilding and stabilisation.
The report will inform on the number of contributions to the TF that took place after the EC communicating interest in the intervention.

ECs support to the OTP Trust Fund has triggered the involvement and donations of a number of stateswhose involvement materialized in the signature of agreements with the ICC and financial contributions to the Trust Fund Among these more than 10 UE member states.This shows a strong multilateral interest commitment and participation in enhancing the ICC capacities to fight against crime and impunity.
